title: Queue burst memory bridge calls and resync canonical entries missed by Hindsight mirror

reproduction.before_fix: When a closed meeting writes two persona entries (p-alpha-meeting, p-beta-meeting) and one institutional meeting minute (mem-meeting-minute) together, services/memory/hindsight_index.py spawned up to MAX_MIRROR_WORKERS=4 concurrent retain threads while services/openclaw-gateway-adapter/memory_llm_bridge.py acquired its max_concurrency=2 semaphore with blocking=False and immediately returned 429 concurrency_limit. mirror_entry exhausted its 3 retries (0.5s + 1.0s = 1.5s) while the first two 1.7s LLM calls were still in flight and dropped mem-meeting-minute (retained=2, failed=1, reason=hindsight_http_429) without a catch-up mechanism.
reproduction.after_fix: MemoryLlmBridge waits up to bounded slot_wait_seconds (default 15.0s via MEMORY_LLM_BRIDGE_SLOT_WAIT_SECONDS, bounded by remaining request deadline; 0.0 restores immediate non-blocking refusal) before returning 429 concurrency_limit; hindsight_index defaults PANTHEON_MEMORY_MIRROR_WORKERS=1, honours bounded HTTP 429 Retry-After in HindsightClient and mirror_entry, retains any entry that still fails immediate retries in a bounded in-memory resync map (capped at MAX_PENDING_MIRRORS=256) retried on a bounded backoff timer (at most once per 60s while pending_resync_count > 0, stopping when empty), exposes pending_resync_count via GET /api/memory/health alongside existing mirror diagnostics, and runs idempotent non-destructive catch_up_mirrors at memory service startup without calling delete_bank. All 4 concurrent burst retains against a max_concurrency=2 bridge converge to mirrored with zero dropped entries.

runtime_budget.in_memory_resync_map_estimated_max_bytes: < 256 KB (256 canonical entry references keyed by (bank, canonical_id))
runtime_budget.resync_timer_cadence: At most once per 60 seconds (exponential backoff 60s -> 120s -> 240s -> 300s cap) while pending_resync_count > 0; timer stops and cancels when pending_resync_count reaches 0
